rules.statement: A claim for money payable on demand must be brought within three years from the demand as per section 7 of the Prescription Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: The High Court failed to appreciate that the true character of the cause of action was a claim of money payable " on demand" and that in terms of section 7 of the Prescription Ordinance the action had been filed within 3 years of the demand

meta.parties: Seylan Bank Limited Vs. Intertrade Garments (Private) Limited
